episodes.title: Go for Broke
episodes.summary: An accident at sea cripples a Royal Navy expedition, forcing its captains to make a dire choice.

episodes.title: Gore
episodes.summary: After a long winter trapped in the ice, scouting parties are sent out in search of open water. One of the teams makes a frightening discovery.

episodes.title: The Ladder
episodes.summary: With something stalking the ships, the expedition's commanders debate their dwindling options.

episodes.title: Punished, as a Boy
episodes.summary: A series of cunning attacks on the ships proves to the men they are not battling an ordinary bear.

episodes.title: First Shot a Winner, Lads
episodes.summary: A strange illness begins to show itself while another more familiar one jeopardizes the expedition's most valuable resource - its captain's judgment.

episodes.title: A Mercy
episodes.summary: With the end of their provisions in sight, officers contemplate a tough, risky strategy while struggling to raise the men's worsening spirits.

episodes.title: Horrible from Supper
episodes.summary: As the men make new attempts to find rescue, a series of shocking events underscores how vulnerable and exposed their situation has become.

episodes.title: Terror Camp Clear
episodes.summary: Deaths under mysterious circumstances create paranoia among the men, and some of the crew may be considering mutiny.

episodes.title: The C, the C, the Open C
episodes.summary: Hope comes in strange forms, and the question of what the men are willing to do to survive begins to be settled in both noble and horrifying ways.

episodes.title: We Are Gone
episodes.summary: The expedition's epic journey reaches its climax as men find themselves in a final confrontation with the Inuit mythology they've trespassed into.

episodes.title: A Sparrow in a Swallow's Nest
episodes.summary: In 1941, Chester Nakayama finds himself caught between his insular Japanese American neighborhood on Terminal Island, California, and his current life as an all-American guy. When extreme circumstances push both his community and personal life to the brink, Chester must grapple with what kind of a man he wants to be, all while someone watches closely.

episodes.title: All the Demons Are Still in Hell
episodes.summary: In the wake of Pearl Harbor, the Terminal Islanders are evicted from their homes by the US Army and must find shelter elsewhere. While Henry, separated from his family, faces injustice at the hands of the government, Chester engages in a paranoid search for answers surrounding the mysterious events of the past weeks.

episodes.title: Gaman
episodes.summary: As the Terminal Islanders struggle with adjusting to their new surroundings, Chester searches for a way to provide for his family and for Luz, and to fend off the evil that he feels is following him. Henry reels from the trauma of his imprisonment. Asako tries to deal with bad omens. Amy takes up a new job.

episodes.title: The Weak Are Meat
episodes.summary: Chester, off in search of a better life, is treated with hostility by his fellow Americans. Luz hopes to be accepted by Henry and Asako in their new home as the Japanese American community celebrates Obon, a festival to commemorate the spirits of those who have died.

episodes.title: Shatter Like a Pearl
episodes.summary: The Japanese Americans are forced to undertake a humiliating exercise that divides the community. Chester comes face to face with a man who forces Chester to question his very nature. Luz, stricken by grief after tragedy, is forced to make an important choice.

episodes.title: Taizo
episodes.summary: A story of the past provides insight into the present evil that stalks the Terminal Islanders. Chester returns home to his family, only to find that someone he was searching for is gone. Henry and Asako are faced with a difficult decision.

episodes.title: My Perfect World
episodes.summary: Chester searches for the person he believes can help; a tuberculosis outbreak forces Amy to act.

episodes.title: My Sweet Boy
episodes.summary: Chester and Luz reach a turning point in their relationship; Amy takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Come and Get Me
episodes.summary: The Terminal Islanders return home; the Nakayamas must come together to battle their greatest foe.

episodes.title: Into the Afterlife
episodes.summary: Henry and Asako look to the past to provide answers to their current turmoil. Chester and Luz grapple with their identities in hopes of saving those who are dearest to them. Amy and Yamato-san struggle to once again assimilate into American life.

episodes.title: November in My Soul
episodes.summary: Pepper is defending his girlfriend when he's arrested and committed for an involuntary 72 hour psych hold.

episodes.title: Disturbed
episodes.summary: Pepper meets his roommate, Coffee; weird sounds in the ceiling; Pepper is visited by a bloody former inhabitant of New Hyde and attacked by a mysterious entity; Marisol visits and Pepper gets into it with Loochie; Pepper gets ahold of staff keys.

episodes.title: New York in June
episodes.summary: The staff take the patients for pizza and it's total chaos.

episodes.title: A Number in the System
episodes.summary: When the silver door opens, Coffee finds gunfire and gore.

episodes.title: Vermillion
episodes.summary: Director Cleave investigates a death. New Hyde will be closed; Dorry's first trip to New Hyde; Dr. Walter does an unnecessary lobotomy; the devil wants out; Miss Chris opens the silver door; Dorry losses everything, Anand pays the price.

episodes.title: Starry Night
episodes.summary: A big storm and no power. Everyone is trapped inside.
